longDescription:
AI Certify (ai-certificates.app) helps electrical and compliance teams generate professional certificates and reports faster—directly alongside your ServiceM8 workflow.

What it does
- Create and manage electrical certificates and compliance reports with consistent formatting
- AI-assisted extraction from uploaded documents/images (optional) to reduce manual typing
- Generate PDFs ready to share with customers, insurers, or auditors
- Keep customer/site details consistent across reports

How it works
- Connect the add-on to your ServiceM8 account
- Use job/customer details to populate report workflows
- Generate your certificate/report PDF and store it with the job documentation

Data & privacy
- Only processes the data needed to provide certificate/report generation and (if enabled) AI-assisted analysis.
- See the full privacy policy for details.
tags: certificates, electrical, compliance, reports, PDF, fire alarm, emergency lighting, ServiceM8, AI
description: AI-assisted certificate and compliance report generation for ServiceM8 jobs—create professional PDFs faster with optional document/image extraction.
